PLAN "3-Week Powerlifting Peak"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Peak for powerlifting meet"

PHASES
  PHASE "Peaking Block" (3 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Heavy Day - Squat Focus":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 5x3 rpe 8 rest 180 seconds
          deadlift 3x3 rpe 8 rest 180 seconds
          front_squat 3x5 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 10m
      DAY Wednesday training 60m "Heavy Day - Bench Focus":
        warmup:
          rowing 10m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 5x3 rpe 8 rest 180 seconds
          incline_press 3x5 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          tricep_extension 3x8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 10m
      DAY Friday training 75m "Heavy Day - Deadlift/Accessory":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          deadlift 5x3 rpe 8 rest 180 seconds
          barbell_row 4x6 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          back_extension 3x8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 10m
      DAY Sunday training 30m "Recovery Mobility":
        warmup:
          cycling 10m
        main straight_sets:
          plank 3x60..60 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          bird_dog 3x10..10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          cat_cow 10m
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Intensity Hold - Squat":
        warmup:
          walking 8m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 4x2 rpe 8.5 rest 180 seconds
          front_squat 3x4 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 8m
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Intensity Hold - Bench":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 4x2 rpe 8.5 rest 180 seconds
          incline_press 3x4 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 3x8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 8m
      DAY Friday training 60m "Intensity Hold - Deadlift":
        warmup:
          walking 8m
        main straight_sets:
          deadlift 4x2 rpe 8.5 rest 180 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 3x5 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          back_extension 3x6 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 8m
      DAY Sunday training 30m "Light Recovery":
        warmup:
          cycling 10m
        main straight_sets:
          plank 3x45..45 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          hollow_hold 3x30..30 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          child_pose 10m
    WEEK 3:
      DAY Monday training 40m "Taper - Openers Practice":
        warmup:
          walking 8m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 3x1 rpe 8 rest 240 seconds
          bench_press 3x1 rpe 8 rest 240 seconds
          deadlift 2x1 rpe 8 rest 240 seconds
        cooldown:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 10m
      DAY Wednesday training 30m "Meet Week - Sharpness":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 2x1 rpe 7.5 rest 240 seconds
          bench_press 2x1 rpe 7.5 rest 240 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 6m
      DAY Friday training 20m "Deload - Travel/Rest Day":

          plank 2x30..30 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 10m

        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          mobility 1x1 rpe 4 rest 0 seconds
